messages:
Alex P: quick question — I hit a segfault in prod service-io a few mins ago, need to pull the related logs for a deeper look. Is it okay to scp them to my laptop for analysis?
Jordan: short answer: no personal laptop copies unless you have JIT access approved. use the jumpbox + ephemeral session.
Alex P: ah ok, I didn't realize JIT was required for small traces. link to the runbook?
Jordan: runbook: https://redwood.ai/runbooks/secure-debug (see section 'log exfiltration and redaction')
Jordan: process is: request JIT via /access (include reason + duration), get approval from oncall lead or security, then scp only to the jumpbox and redact before export.
Alex P: got it. what's the recommended redaction command for obvious PII (emails, 12-digit ids, ip)?
Maria C: quick helpers we use: 
```sh
# redact emails and long numeric ids
sed -E 's/[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,6}/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g; s/\b[0-9]{10,}\b/[REDACTED_ID]/g'
```
Maria C: also run the `redact-logs` tool on the jumpbox — it strips tokens, auth headers, and internal hostnames.
Alex P: thanks. If I need a quick one-off to triage, can I request 15m JIT and then paste a small snippet in #eng-oncall?
Security: paste only after redaction and strip request IDs and IPs. prefer a minimal excerpt, not full logs. never post stack traces with user ids.
Sam B: if it's urgent and impacting customers, ping the oncall lead + add a short note in the incident doc (inc-###). JIT approvals are fast during paging.
Alex P: ok requesting JIT now for 15m, reason: investigate segfault in consumer-shard-12, will redact before any paste. tagging @Security for visibility.
Oncall Bot: Access request created (req-98432). Approver: Jordan. Expires: 15m after approval.
Jordan: approved req-98432 for 15m. Remember to record session id in the incident doc.
Alex P: approved — connected via jumpbox, running `redact-logs` now. will report back with safe excerpt. :thumbsup:
Maria C: tiny note for runbook update: add the sed snippet and mention `redact-logs` exit code check (non-zero -> fail export). can someone make a quick PR?
Alex P: I can add the snippet in a follow-up PR after I finish triage.
Security: +1 on PR. also add reminder to revoke any temporary keys and to use ephemeral SCP flags (no persistent authorized_keys).
Sam B: thanks everyone. keeping this short: no laptop copies without exception, always JIT, redact, and record. :white_check_mark:
Alex P: will follow up with a safe excerpt in ~10m.
Oncall Bot: Access req-98432 expired at 1834568050. If further time needed, reopen with justification.
